titleEn: Maximum Product of the Length of Two Palindromic Substrings
title: 两个回文子字符串长度的最大乘积
summary: 在字符串中选择两个不重叠的奇数长度回文子串，求长度乘积最大值。
insight: Manacher 求每个中心最大奇回文。把最大回文长度记录到其终点和起点，再用缩短两端的性质传播所有内部回文，形成每个前缀与后缀的最大可用长度；枚举分割点相乘。

solutions.title: Manacher 与前后缀最大值
solutions.idea: 线性获得每个分割点两侧的最佳奇回文。
steps: 记录 exactEnd[center+r-1] 与 exactStart[center-r+1] 的最大长度；分别传播缩短二的内部回文
对 exactEnd 做前缀最大、exactStart 做后缀最大，枚举 split 计算乘积

code.java: class Solution { public long maxProduct(String s){int n=s.length();int[] radius=new int[n];for(int i=0,left=0,right=-1;i<n;i++){int value=i>right?1:Math.min(radius[left+right-i],right-i+1);while(i-value>=0&&i+value<n&&s.charAt(i-value)==s.charAt(i+value))value++;radius[i]=value;if(i+value-1>right){left=i-value+1;right=i+value-1;}}int[] end=new int[n],start=new int[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++){int length=2*radius[i]-1;end[i+radius[i]-1]=Math.max(end[i+radius[i]-1],length);start[i-radius[i]+1]=Math.max(start[i-radius[i]+1],length);}for(int i=n-2;i>=0;i--)end[i]=Math.max(end[i],end[i+1]-2);for(int i=1;i<n;i++)end[i]=Math.max(end[i],end[i-1]);for(int i=1;i<n;i++)start[i]=Math.max(start[i],start[i-1]-2);for(int i=n-2;i>=0;i--)start[i]=Math.max(start[i],start[i+1]);long answer=0;for(int i=0;i+1<n;i++)answer=Math.max(answer,(long)end[i]*start[i+1]);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxProduct(s:String):Long{val n=s.length;val radius=IntArray(n);var left=0;var right=-1;for(i in 0 until n){var value=if(i>right)1 else minOf(radius[left+right-i],right-i+1);while(i-value>=0&&i+value<n&&s[i-value]==s[i+value])value++;radius[i]=value;if(i+value-1>right){left=i-value+1;right=i+value-1}};val end=IntArray(n);val start=IntArray(n);for(i in 0 until n){val length=2*radius[i]-1;end[i+radius[i]-1]=maxOf(end[i+radius[i]-1],length);start[i-radius[i]+1]=maxOf(start[i-radius[i]+1],length)};for(i in n-2 downTo 0)end[i]=maxOf(end[i],end[i+1]-2);for(i in 1 until n)end[i]=maxOf(end[i],end[i-1]);for(i in 1 until n)start[i]=maxOf(start[i],start[i-1]-2);for(i in n-2 downTo 0)start[i]=maxOf(start[i],start[i+1]);var answer=0L;for(i in 0 until n-1)answer=maxOf(answer,end[i].toLong()*start[i+1]);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: long long maxProduct(string s){int n=s.size();vector<int> radius(n);for(int i=0,left=0,right=-1;i<n;++i){int value=i>right?1:min(radius[left+right-i],right-i+1);while(i-value>=0&&i+value<n&&s[i-value]==s[i+value])++value;radius[i]=value;if(i+value-1>right){left=i-value+1;right=i+value-1;}}vector<int> ending(n),starting(n);for(int i=0;i<n;++i){int length=2*radius[i]-1;ending[i+radius[i]-1]=max(ending[i+radius[i]-1],length);starting[i-radius[i]+1]=max(starting[i-radius[i]+1],length);}for(int i=n-2;i>=0;--i)ending[i]=max(ending[i],ending[i+1]-2);for(int i=1;i<n;++i)ending[i]=max(ending[i],ending[i-1]);for(int i=1;i<n;++i)starting[i]=max(starting[i],starting[i-1]-2);for(int i=n-2;i>=0;--i)starting[i]=max(starting[i],starting[i+1]);long long answer=0;for(int i=0;i+1<n;++i)answer=max(answer,1LL*ending[i]*starting[i+1]);return answer;} };
